summary: One turn of a conversation: the person's in a raised bubble on the right, the assistant's as text on the left with Copy, Retry and a thumbs up.

props.name: from
props.description: Who wrote it: the person's turn sits on the right in a raised bubble, the assistant's on the left as plain text.

props.name: name
props.description: A name over an assistant's message.

props.name: avatar
props.description: A small mark beside the name, such as the model's.

props.name: copyText
props.description: The text Copy puts on the clipboard. Without it there is no Copy.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Adds Retry under an assistant's message.

props.name: onFeedback
props.description: Adds a thumbs up under an assistant's message, called with its new state.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the bubble and the action buttons. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

children.text: Which folders take the most space?
